method: One selected G32/PDL/clocked-codec/initial-audio-graph model, separate control/candidate graph sets. Both use selected first-1/16 hints; candidate removes redundant zero-lookahead modulo only in QKV. Gate/up, down and attention-output projections are unchanged. Alternating full cached-voice requests, one excluded warmup pair. Global function bindings are scoped to this isolated benchmark process and restored; no serving change or profiler during timing.
